描述_EN: a porcelain factory was established at korzec in poland around 1784 by a member of the czartoryski family, where there was a large deposit of china-clay. the factory was destroyed by fire in 1796. it was restarted in 1803 and continued until 1831.
描述_ZN: 1784年左右，沙尔托里斯基家族的一个成员在波兰的科尔泽克建立了一家瓷器厂，那里有大量的中国粘土矿。 该工厂在1796年被火烧毁。 它在1803年被重新启动，并持续到1831年。
